source.tau_R: SD of pooled R-Tuning minus probe over the 4 model-split cells of 2610.31820 Table 3 code = 0.0129, rounded to 0.02
source.tau_P: SD of the 4 pooled probe AUROCs of 2610.31820 Table 3 code = 0.0411, rounded to 0.04 and applied to within-problem AUROC (assumption: same order of spread)
source.tau_0: SD of the 4 pooled verbalized AUROCs of 2610.31820 Table 3 code = 0.0126, rounded up to 0.02
source.tau_aP/tau_aS: no direct literature value; tuned (16-world population check: 0.15/0.08 gives G0 SD 0.039, 0.25/0.12 gives 0.053; 0.22/0.11 chosen) so the between-model SD of the raw gap G0 matches the SD of the 4 pooled probe-minus-verbalized gaps = 0.0493 (check in heterogeneity_check block)
source.tau_f: assumption (no located source): SD 0.03 around a 0.08 false-pass fraction of failing samples

source.tau_R: SD of the two Campos Table V within-problem gaps (judging-pass minus code-token probe: Qwen3-Coder, gpt-oss) = 0.0410 (n = 2), rounded to 0.04
source.tau_P: twice nominal; the Campos code-token probe within-problem AUROCs (.620, .781) have SD 0.1138 (n = 2), larger still (see extreme)

source.tau_R: just under the larger Campos within-problem gap in absolute value (0.067), used as a model-level SD (a deliberate overstatement)
source.tau_P: SD of the Campos code-token probe within-problem AUROCs (n = 2) = 0.1138

other_assumptions.fixed_effects: R_m = R* + u_m, u_m ~ N(0, tau_R^2) centered to mean zero per world; trained separation d1_m calibrated per model so the population within-AUROC residual equals R_m
other_assumptions.random_effects: same, u_m not centered; decision still judged against R* (sensitivity only)
other_assumptions.refit_rule: s_refit^2 = Var_ddof1 over 3 seeds of Rbar with probe refit in all models (S at seed 0) + (M / n_sub) * Var_ddof1 over 3 seeds of Rbar with trained readout refit in the n_sub sub-study models only (probe and other models at seed 0); half-width sqrt(h^2 + (1.645 s_refit)^2) about the percentile interval center
other_assumptions.seed0_perturbation: the observed Rbar uses seed-0 perturbed separations; the estimand R* is defined at the unperturbed calibrated separation
other_assumptions.lexicographic_ties: W of the recalibrated readout equals W of the pre-map bins; pooled AUROC ranks by (isotonic value, bin)
other_assumptions.decisions_use: R on EvalPlus labels (true y) only; weak-suite labels enter only G0 and the Shapley cells

greedy_to_T1_rule.reason: the two anchors move in opposite directions (-20.6 and +3.3 points); the baseline in the paper is temperature 0.2, not greedy; two models cannot define a relation
greedy_to_T1_rule.rule_applied: mu at T = 1 is the candidate (identity, Qwen shift, Qwen ratio, Mistral shift) with the fewest mixed problems at kappa conservative; for greedy above 0.5 this is the identity
